title: Major dependency upgrades blocked by caret bounds
description:
cargo update clears everything inside the declared semver ranges (done, aaa70a0). Eleven crates sit behind a major bound that only a Cargo.toml edit can cross. Tracked as separate issues because each is an independent migration with its own breakage surface; a big-bang upgrade would make failures impossible to attribute.

Baseline at filing: tests 37/37 green, cargo audit exit 0, clippy exit 101 (two pre-existing errors, persona-5s4b.27).
